transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well... I suppose it's my sleep. It's become completely unmoored lately. 

At first, I was only getting maybe two or three hours... but I'd get up feeling ready to go, drafting plans for things. Now, though... I just lie awake before dawn. My stomach gets tight, and... I just don't get any sense of rest. That's about it, really.
Do you find yourself feeling anxious or worried a lot, especially around the time you're trying to fall asleep?
I suppose... yes, a bit. I wouldn't call it worry, exactly. Just... my mind won't settle down. It's just hard to turn it off.
Do you find yourself worrying about a variety of different things — like work, relationships, or health — even when there isn’t a clear reason to be concerned?
No, I wouldn't say that. I don't really sit around fretting over specific things like that. I'm not working anymore anyway, so... no. It's not a list of concerns. It's just... hard to sleep.
How long have you been experiencing these difficulties with sleep, and does it seem to come and go, or has it been continuous?
I couldn't give you an exact timeframe. A while, I suppose. I haven't really kept track of whether it stops and starts... it just seems to be how things are right now.
Do you feel excessively tired or fatigued during the day, even after a night of poor sleep?
No... I wouldn't say so. I mean, I'm up and about. I don't really feel all that tired during the day.

Can you tell me more about the specific difficulties you're having with sleep? For example, do you have trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or do you wake up too early and can't get back to sleep?

Well, it's... it's just unmoored, I suppose. At first, I'd wake up after maybe two or three hours, and I'd be drafting plans... feeling completely ready to go. But now... now I just lie awake before dawn. My stomach gets tight. There's just no... no sense of rest anymore.
Have you noticed that you’ve lost interest or pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?

I suppose so. Yes. I... I used to spend whole afternoons at the museum. Or I'd take my camera out. I used to cook quite a bit, too. But lately... I just look at the camera, or think about going to the bridge table, and... there's just nothing. Just the thought of how much effort it would take to pretend I care. So I don't bother.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, lately?
I don't know if I'd use the word depressed. I'm not... sitting around feeling sad, if that's what you mean. It's mostly just what I said before. Just... empty, I suppose.
Have you noticed any trouble thinking clearly, concentrating, or making decisions lately?
I don't... I haven't really noticed anything like that. I mean, I'm not doing much of anything, so there aren't exactly many decisions to make. Just... no, I wouldn't say I've had trouble with that.
Have you found it harder to focus on things, like reading or watching a show, even if it’s something you used to enjoy?
I haven't really been watching much. Or reading. So... I couldn't tell you. I just haven't been doing those things.
Would you say you have a persistently low mood, like a heaviness or emptiness that doesn't go away, even if it's not exactly sadness?

I don't really know about a low mood. I... I already said it feels empty. I haven't really thought about whether it's heavy, or if it goes away. It's just... how it is. I don't really have much else to say about it.
Have you noticed a loss of energy or feel fatigued, even if it's not tied to physical activity?
I don't... no. I'm not really doing anything to get tired from in the first place. I just sit there. So... I wouldn't call it fatigue.
Would you say there's a general feeling that stays with you throughout the day, like a background of emptiness or low mood, even if it's not exactly sadness?
I thought we just went over this. I... I don't really keep track of how I feel all day. It's just time passing. I don't know what else to tell you.
Would you say you’ve lost interest in everything, not just specific activities you mentioned like the museum or cooking?

I suppose. I mean... I used to do things. Lose myself in photography, or cooking... spend whole afternoons at the museum. But lately... I just look at my camera, or the bridge table... and I don't feel anything. Just... thinking about the effort it would take to pretend. So I don't.
Would you say that you’ve lost interest in almost everything, not just the specific things you mentioned like photography or cooking?
I... I just said that. Yes. I don't really care about anything right now.
Have you noticed any difficulty thinking clearly, focusing your attention, or concentrating on tasks lately?
I don't know. I guess... I just don't do much that requires a lot of thought right now. So I haven't really noticed.
Would you say that most days feel emotionally flat or devoid of any positive feeling, like nothing really brings any sense of satisfaction or joy anymore?
I don't know. I'm not really keeping track of... joy, or things like that. I just get through the day. I haven't really thought about it in those terms.
Would you say that you have trouble thinking clearly or concentrating, even on simple things, like following a conversation or making small decisions?
I... I mean, conversations are fine, I guess. I'm talking to you. Decisions... I don't really have to make many right now. My wife handles most of it. So... no, I haven't really noticed.
Would you say that nothing you do, even things you used to enjoy, brings you any real sense of pleasure or satisfaction anymore?

I suppose. I used to... well, I used to spend whole afternoons at the museum. Or I'd get into photography, or cooking. But lately... I don't know. I look at my camera, or the bridge table, and... I don't feel anything. It just feels like... like it would take too much effort just to pretend I care. So I don't.
